files.window: all future events listed by the site (one: Coffee and Chat, Sat 21 Nov 2026, 10.30-11.30, St Mary's Church Hall)
files.notes: ASP.NET WebForms (IIS 8.5), server-rendered. Events are in two GridViews: #ctl00_maincontent_GridViewList (desktop) and #ctl00_maincontent_GridViewListMobile; each row has a date heading ('Saturday, 21 November 2026'), a title and a free-text description holding the time and place. Times are prose ('10.30-11.30'), so a selector parser should treat a missing/unparseable time as all-day or a parse error, not a guess. Low volume (~1 event a month).
